crossRefs.note: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish…
Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping…
God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me…
For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I…
God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and…
“ ‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.
“See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels…
Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive plants around your…
Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.
Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

translations.web: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
translations.bsb: Then God blessed them and said, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters of the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
translations.kjv: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
translations.asv: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.
